import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    coord = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            coord[i][j] = int(next(it))
    bad = [False]*n
    count = n
    for i in range(n):
        if has_positive_dot(i, n, coord):
            bad[i] = True
            count -= 1
    print(count)
    for i in range(n):
        if not bad[i]:
            print(i+1)

def has_positive_dot(i, n, coord):
    for j in range(n):
        if j == i:
            continue
        for k in range(n):
            if k == i or k == j:
                continue
            prod = 0
            for m in range(5):
                a = coord[j][m] - coord[i][m]
                b = coord[k][m] - coord[i][m]
                prod += a * b
            if prod > 0:
                return True
    return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
